props.name: icon
props.description: A 16px icon before the title.

props.name: data-force
props.description: Show a state without interacting, for state sheets.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Runs on click. The spinner stays until its promise settles.

props.name: state
props.description: Drive the state from outside instead.

props.name: minLoading
props.description: Shortest time the spinner shows, in ms.

props.name: resetAfter
props.description: How long the checkmark stays before the button is ready again, in ms; `null` keeps it.

props.name: onError
props.description: Called when `onAction` rejects; without it the error is rethrown.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: The icon after the label; `null` for none. Defaults to an arrow.

ActivityTimelineTime.description: A `<time>`: relative today ("5 min ago"), the clock time before that, kept current by the shared clock. Screen readers hear the full date and time instead. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `time` element.

props.name: withDate
props.description: Past today, show the date before the clock time (for a timeline not grouped by day).

ActivityTimelineRoot.description: The timeline's root on its own: Revert, its toast, and the fade of new entries for the parts inside.

props.name: onRevert
props.description: Reverts an entry. Return a promise and the button spins until it settles; once it resolves the entry shows as reverted and a toast offers Undo. A rejection puts the button back.

props.name: onUndoRevert
props.description: Undoes a revert, from the toast's Undo. Without it the toast has no Undo.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows skeleton rows (ActivityTimeline) and marks the region busy.

ActivityTimelineList.description: An ordered list of entries and runs, newest first. Name it (`aria-label`) when no day names it. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `ol`.

ActivityTimelineDay.description: A day: its name, then its entries in a list named after it. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `ol`.

props.name: day
props.description: The day: a Date (named "Today", "Yesterday" or by its date) or your own words.

ActivityTimelineEntry.description: One entry: the actor on the rail, the sentence, the time, the changes and Revert. Inside an ActivityTimelineRoot it can be reverted. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `li`.

props.name: withDate
props.description: Past today, write the date before the time (for a timeline not grouped by day).

ActivityTimelineRun.description: Several entries by one actor folded into one row: "Agent made 6 changes", a button that opens onto them (their own list, opening in height). Other props, `ref` included, go to the `li`.

props.name: actor
props.description: Whose run it is: their avatar on the rail and their name in the summary.

props.name: count
props.description: How many entries are folded.

props.name: at
props.description: The newest entry's time, beside the summary.

props.name: withDate
props.description: Past today, write the date before the time.

props.name: summary
props.description: In place of "Agent made 6 changes".

props.name: children
props.description: The run's entries (ActivityTimelineEntry), shown when it opens.

ActivityTimeline.description: A record's history from `items`, newest first: a list under its name for each day, runs of one actor folded, Revert with a toast and Undo. The root is a group named "Activity" (`activity` in SatinLabels); pass `aria-labelledby` when a heading of yours names it. Other props, `ref` included, go to the root `div`.

props.name: items
props.description: The entries, in any order: the timeline shows the newest first.

props.name: groupBy
props.description: A list under its name for each day, or one list.

props.name: collapseRuns
props.description: Runs of this many entries or more by one actor fold into one row; `false` never folds.

props.name: expanded
props.description: The open runs, by the id of any entry in them.

props.name: empty
props.description: Shown when there are no items. Defaults to "No activity yet".

ReviewableChanges.description: One change per step of a DecisionCard; see above. Other props, `ref` included, go to the card's `div`.

props.name: changes
props.description: The fields the agent wants to change, as AgentSuggestionChanges takes them; add an `id` to each to key `value` by it.

props.name: title
props.description: The suggestion, in the header: "Update the Quanta deal". Without it, each change's field is the title.

props.name: description
props.description: A muted line under the title: "Based on today's call".

props.name: value
props.description: Each change's decision, by id (controlled). A change left out is pending.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The decisions to start from (uncontrolled). Everything is pending without it.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with every decision whenever one changes.

props.name: defaultStep
props.description: The change to open on, by its place in `changes`. Defaults to the first.

props.name: onApply
props.description: The review is done: gets the accepted changes only, in their order, and every decision. Not called when none is accepted. Return a promise to hold the `applying` stage until it settles; if it rejects, review starts again.

props.name: onApplied
props.description: Called once the accepted changes are applied (or none was) and the card has left: remove it here (it stays faded out until you do). Gets what `onApply` got.

props.name: returnFocus
props.description: Where focus goes when the card leaves with focus inside it: the record it updated, the next suggestion. Without it, or when it gives nothing, focus goes to the page's body.

props.name: status
props.description: Holds the stage yourself; without it, it follows `onApply`.

TetrisStill.description: The tetris mark at rest, every dot filled: the finished header's mark.

TetrisLabel.description: The label beside the mark: a shimmer, and on top a copy of the text the band crosses after the mark, on the same loop, so the light runs from the icon on through the word.

ShimmerLabel.description: The label shimmer alone (a band of ink passing through muted text), for the flappy header.

FlappySprite.description: @internal Shared by Satin's own components; not part of the public API and may change in any release.

props.name: label
props.description: The live label. Defaults to the `thinking` label ("Thinking…").

props.name: time
props.description: Elapsed time after the label, e.g. "1.2s".

props.name: indicator
props.description: The mark beside the label.

props.name: glimmer
props.description: The light that crosses the tetris mark and its label as rows clear: glimm's prism, or neutral.

AgentPermissionRoot.description: The card and its state; the parts go inside. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `div`.

props.name: agent
props.description: Who asks: a name, or an Agent picker agent (`{ name, initials, tone, avatar }`).

props.name: scopes
props.description: What it asks for, one row each: `{ resource, actions, detail }`.

props.name: value
props.description: The ticked scopes' ids (`id`, or `resource`).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The ticked scopes to start from. Defaults to every scope.

props.name: onAllow
props.description: Allow once (`once`) or Always allow (`always`), with the ticked scopes. Return a promise and the button shows a Spinner until it settles; if it rejects, the request stays as it was.

props.name: onDeny
props.description: Don't allow. A promise works as for `onAllow`.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus Don't allow, the safest answer, when the request appears. Defaults to true inside a Dialog and false elsewhere, so a request arriving in a chat never takes the keys from someone typing.

AgentPermissionHeader.description: The agent's avatar in a tile of its tone, over an aura of the same tone, and "<agent> wants to:" centred under it, with why it asks. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `div`.

props.name: description
props.description: Why it asks, in a sentence: "To screen this week's applicants for Product Designer."

AgentPermissionScopeList.description: The scopes as a list, one row each, kept apart by space rather than rules. Without children it lists `scopes`. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `ul`.

AgentPermissionScope.description: One scope: its verb as an icon, its title and detail, and a Checkbox. The whole row is the Checkbox's label. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `li`.

props.name: scope
props.description: The scope this row asks for. Its tick is the `value` entry under its id.

AgentPermissionFooter.description: The answers: Don't allow, then Allow once with Always allow in its menu. While some scopes are unticked, how many are left sits on the other side. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `div`.

AgentPermissionRequest.description: The request from props: the header, the scopes and the answers. Other props, `ref` included, go to the card's `div`.

props.name: description
props.description: Why it asks, in a sentence under the title.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected agent's id.

props.name: showDescription
props.description: Show the one-line description under each name. Turn it off once agents are familiar.

props.name: variant
props.description: Secondary under the composer, Tertiary inside dense toolbars.

props.name: size
props.description: md is the 28px trigger, xs the 24px one.

props.name: onCreate
props.description: Adds a "New agent" action under the list.

props.name: createLabel
props.description: Label for the create action. Defaults to the `newAgent` label.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown on the trigger when nothing is selected. Defaults to the `chooseAgent` label.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state, e.g. to show the menu open on a docs stage.

props.name: disablePortal
props.description: Render the menu in place instead of in a portal.

AgentMenuItem.description: One row of the menu, `DropdownMenu/Item`. Must sit inside the picker's radio group.

AgentPickerRow.description: A static menu row for state sheets and docs (no menu around it): the same look as a menu item, with `state` forced to default, hover or selected.

AgentAvatar.description: Initials on a Badge hue pair, round. 16px uses semibold 7/8, 20px semibold 9/10, as on the uiKit Avatar. These sizes have no type token, so they stay raw. `avatar="flappy"` draws the flappy bird instead, in the agent's tone.

AgentPlanRoot.description: The card and its state; the parts go inside. Other props, `ref` included, go to the card's `div`.

props.name: steps
props.description: The steps, in order (controlled).

props.name: defaultSteps
props.description: The steps to start from (uncontrolled).

props.name: onStepsChange
props.description: Called with every step after a rename, a move, a removal, or a skip.

props.name: status
props.description: `draft` while the person edits the plan; `running`, `failed` and `done` show it read-only.

props.name: currentStep
props.description: The id of the step running, or the one that failed. Steps before it are done.

props.name: onRun
props.description: Run plan was pressed: run these steps (all but the skipped ones), in this order.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Shows Stop while the plan runs or waits at a failed step.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Shows Retry under the failed step.

props.name: onSkip
props.description: Shows Skip under the failed step. The step is marked `skipped` first, through `onStepsChange`.

props.name: error
props.description: Why the current step failed, under it.

props.name: indicator
props.description: The current step's mark, as on AgentLoading.

props.name: glimmer
props.description: The light across the tetris mark and the label, as on AgentLoading.

AgentPlanHeader.description: The title; it names the plan. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `div`.

props.name: title
props.description: What the plan is for, e.g. "Schedule interviews for 3 shortlisted candidates". Defaults to the `agentPlan` label ("Plan").

AgentPlanSteps.description: The steps as an ordered list: editable rows in a draft, Thinking's steps on a rail once the plan runs. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `div` around the list.

AgentPlanActions.description: Run plan in a draft (disabled while no step is left in), Stop while it runs or waits at a failed step (with `onStop`). Children go before the button. Nothing shows once it's done, unless you pass children. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `div`.

AgentPlan.description: The plan from props: the title, the steps, and Run plan or Stop. Other props, `ref` included, go to the card's `div`.

props.name: title
props.description: What the plan is for, e.g. "Schedule interviews for 3 shortlisted candidates". Defaults to the `agentPlan` label ("Plan").

AgentPresenceRoot.description: Tracks the target and lays a box over it, the size of the target, for the outline and the label inside; speaks `announcement` from a polite status region. Other props, `ref` included, go to the layer (an absolutely positioned `div`, hidden from screen readers).

props.name: target
props.description: The element the agent is on: a ref, the element, or a selector. `null` hides the presence (it fades out).

props.name: state
props.description: `working` in the agent's tone, `done` green (then it fades out), `conflict` amber: a person edits the same target.

props.name: tone
props.description: The agent's tone while it works, the Badge hue pairs. Done is always green, conflict amber.

props.name: announcement
props.description: What screen readers hear, politely, each time it changes: "Satin is updating Tara Mendes".

props.name: doneDuration
props.description: How long `done` stays before it fades out, in ms; `Infinity` keeps it.

AgentPresenceOutline.description: The edge over the target, in the state's tone; dashed in a conflict. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `span`.

AgentPresenceLabel.description: The small label on the target's top edge, at its end corner: a small Badge in the state's tone. Put the mark and the words inside. Other props, `ref` included, go to the Badge.

AgentPresence.description: The outline and the label from props: the agent's mark and name (or its `activity`) while it works, a check and Done, or the person's avatar and "Jon Park is editing" in a conflict. Other props, `ref` included, go to the layer.

props.name: agent
props.description: Who is editing: a name, or AgentPicker's agent (its `tone` colours the presence; `avatar: 'flappy'` runs the bird).

props.name: label
props.description: The target's name, for screen readers: "Tara Mendes" makes "Satin is updating Tara Mendes".

props.name: activity
props.description: The step the agent is on while it works, in a few words: "Drafting invite…". The label says it in place of the agent's name; screen readers hear "Satin, Tara Mendes: Drafting invite…".

props.name: person
props.description: For `conflict`: the person editing the same target.

props.name: kind
props.description: What kind of suggestion: "Email suggestion", "Next steps", "CRM update".

props.name: icon
props.description: A 14px icon or app logo before the kind.

props.name: meta
props.description: Right of the kind: avatars of the people it concerns, or a small Badge with the source.

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons, right-aligned: the alternative first, the primary action last.

AgentSuggestionQuote.description: The message the suggestion answers: who sent it and what they wrote, on component/agent-suggestion/quote-bg (bg/canvas in Light, bg/muted in Dark).

props.name: from
props.description: The sender's name.

props.name: avatar
props.description: A 20px Avatar.

AgentSuggestionMetric.description: A number against its limit: the value in Display/sm, its unit, and a 6px bar of how much is used.

props.name: value
props.description: As shown: "47 / 50".

props.name: used
props.description: With `max`, draws the bar.

AgentSuggestionDiff.description: Old text struck through on bg/muted, the new text in status/green below it.

AgentSuggestionChanges.description: Fields the agent will change: name, the old value struck through, an arrow and the new one.

AgentSuggestionChangeValue.description: One change's value as AgentSuggestionChanges draws it: the old value struck through, an arrow and the new one. For a row of your own (one with its own controls). Other props, `ref` included, go to its `span`.

AgentActionLogRoot.description: The log on its own: the state, ⌘Z and the list. `AgentActionLogRun`s go inside.

props.name: runs
props.description: The runs, in the order shown: newest first, usually.

props.name: onRevert
props.description: Reverts one action. Return a promise: the button shows a Spinner until it settles, and a rejection marks the row as failed, with Try again.

props.name: onRevertRun
props.description: Reverts what is left of a run in one go (one request), for Revert run and ⌘Z. Gets the actions still in effect, newest first. Without it, `onRevert` runs for each, newest first.

props.name: onRestore
props.description: Puts reverted actions back: the toast's Undo, and Restore on a reverted row or run. Without it the toast has no Undo and a reverted row just says Reverted.

props.name: reverted
props.description: Ids of the reverted actions, controlled.

props.name: defaultReverted
props.description: Ids of the actions already reverted when the log mounts.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Ids of the open runs, controlled.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Ids of the runs open when the log mounts. Default: the first run.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Where ⌘Z (Ctrl+Z off Apple) reverts the newest run: anywhere on the page (`document`, the default), only while focus is in the log (`log`), or nowhere (`off`).

props.name: formatTime
props.description: Writes a time. Default: the time of day, with the date when it isn't today, in `dateLocale`.

AgentActionLogRun.description: One run: a header that opens onto its actions, on a rail, with Revert run (or Restore run once it's all reverted). Other props, `ref` included, go to its `li`.

props.name: children
props.description: The rows. Default: an `AgentActionLogAction` for each of the run's actions.

AgentActionLogAction.description: One action on one line: its icon, what it did, its target in mono, +added −removed, and a Revert icon button (then Restore or a check; Try again after a failure). One that can't be reverted shows a lock there and says why under it. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `li`.

props.name: state
props.description: Sets the row's state yourself, for a log you drive. Default: the log's.

props.name: children
props.description: More under the action: a link to the diff, a note.

AgentActionLog.description: The log from `runs`: each run's header and its actions, Revert on each, Revert run and ⌘Z for the newest. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `section`.

props.name: layout
props.description: `inline`: one centred row with 12px padding and the 28px close button, as in a PromptBar's `notice`.

props.name: icon
props.description: `false` hides the status icon; a node replaces it.

props.name: action
props.description: A Button or Link, or a few in a fragment.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows the close button; called when it is pressed.

StatusIcon.description: @internal The status glyphs from Figma (16px, 1.25 stroke), drawn in currentColor. Neutral uses the info glyph.

CloseIcon.description: @internal Shared by Satin's own components; not part of the public API and may change in any release.

props.name: action
props.type: { label: React.ReactNode; href?: string; onClick?: () => void }
props.description: The button after the message; with `href` it renders as a link.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Defaults to the `dismissAnnouncement` label.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Sticks to the top or bottom edge of its scroll container.

props.name: tone
props.description: `primary`: action/primary/bg (the default). `inverse`: action/inverse/bg, near-black in light and near-white in dark. `default`: bg/card with border/subtle rules above and below, like a Banner.

props.name: background
props.description: `mesh` lays the Banner's glow over the bar: lighter on primary and inverse, coloured on default.

props.name: shimmer
props.description: Now and then a soft band of light crosses the bar (off under reduced motion).

props.name: meta
props.description: Type and size, e.g. "PDF · 2.4 MB". Shown on `lg` only.

props.name: icon
props.description: File type icon. Defaults to the PDF icon.

props.name: shape
props.description: Rounded inside the composer and chat, Default inside cards and tables.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Shows the remove button. Leave it out once the message is sent.

props.name: preview
props.description: Content for the hover preview, usually an `<AttachmentPreview>`.

AttachmentGroup.description: AttachmentGroup: files wrap onto new rows at 576px, 4px apart.

AttachmentPreview.description: AttachmentPreview: 296 wide, bg/popover, border/subtle, radius-xl, shadcn md shadow. A header with the file, a 176px scrolling viewport with a fade at the bottom, a border/subtle divider and a footer that moves between pages or sheets and opens the file.

props.name: children
props.description: The first page or the first rows. Scrolls inside a fixed 176px viewport.

props.name: navigation
props.description: Left side of the footer: an `AttachmentPreviewPager` or `AttachmentPreviewSheets`.

props.name: openLabel
props.description: Defaults to the `openItem` label.

AttachmentPreviewPager.description: Document footer: previous / next section and "Page 1 of 3".

AttachmentPreviewSheets.description: Spreadsheet footer: one tab per sheet; the current one is filled bg/muted.

FileIcon.description: File type icons from uiKit `icon`. They keep their own colours (library primitives), so they don't follow currentColor.

props.name: initials
props.description: One or two letters, or a count like "+3" at the end of a group.

props.name: name
props.description: The person's name: shown in a tooltip on hover and focus, and read by screen readers.

AvatarGroup.description: A row of avatars sharing one name tooltip. It opens after AVATAR_TOOLTIP_DELAY on the first person; while it's open, the next person gets it at once: it slides along the row (transform, 200 ms, ease-out) and its width eases to the new name, which fades in. It closes AVATAR_TOOLTIP_CLOSE after the pointer leaves the row, so the gaps between faces don't close it. Focus shows it at once, Escape and blur hide it.

props.name: side
props.description: Where the shared name tooltip sits.

props.name: icon
props.description: 16px mark before the title, such as a model's icon.

props.name: action
props.description: One action, usually `<Button variant="secondary">`. Stretches across a sidebar banner.

props.name: tone
props.description: `primary`: action/primary/bg with action/primary/fg text; its mesh glows lighter on top.

props.name: shimmer
props.description: Now and then a soft band of light crosses the banner (off under reduced motion).

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows the close button.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the close button. Defaults to the `dismiss` label.

props.name: mesh
props.description: Replace the mesh images.

props.name: legend
props.type: { label: string; value?: string; note?: string }
props.description: The legend row under the plot.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit after the value in the tooltip ("covers").

props.name: reducedMotion
props.description: Swap the bars without motion when the data changes, as under prefers-reduced-motion.

props.name: items
props.description: From the top level down; the last one is the current page.

props.name: maxItems
props.description: Fold the middle into "…" when there are more items than this.

BulkActionBarRoot.description: The floating toolbar on its own: the parts go inside.

props.name: count
props.description: How many items are selected. The bar shows from 1 and hides at 0.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Empties the selection: the clear button, Escape and the checkbox (when all are selected) call it.

props.name: total
props.description: How many items there are in all, so the checkbox knows when all of them are selected.

props.name: onSelectAll
props.description: Selects every item. With it, the bar starts with a select-all Checkbox.

props.name: position
props.description: `sticky` sits after the content and sticks to the bottom of the screen while its container scrolls past; `absolute` lays it over the container's bottom edge (give the container `position: relative` and `pb-16`).

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Classes for the element that places the bar (sticky or absolute, centred).

BulkActionBarCount.description: The select-all Checkbox (when the root has `onSelectAll`) and "[3] selected", the number in a grey Badge. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `div`.

BulkActionBarClear.description: The clear button (×), at the end of the bar. Other props, `ref` included, go to the Button.

BulkActionBarSeparator.description: A thin rule between the count and the actions, and before the clear button. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `div`.

BulkActionBarAction.description: One action as a button in the bar. Other props, `ref` included, go to the Button.

BulkActionBarOverflow.description: The ⋯ button and its menu, for the actions that don't get a button. Other props, `ref` included, go to the ⋯ Button.

props.name: actions
props.description: The actions in the menu, in order.

BulkActionBar.description: The bar from props: the checkbox and the count, a rule, a button per action, the ⋯ menu, then a rule and the clear button. Other props, `ref` included, go to the toolbar element.

props.name: actions
props.description: The actions, as buttons after the count.

props.name: overflow
props.description: More actions, in a ⋯ menu after the buttons.

props.name: attached
props.description: Join the buttons into one block.

ButtonGroupSeparator.description: A thin rule between sets of buttons in a loose (`attached={false}`) group or a toolbar.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the child element (a link, say) with the button's styles instead of a `<button>`.

props.name: loading
props.description: Busy: a Spinner takes the middle and the label and icons turn invisible but keep their room, so the button doesn't change width. Clicks (and Enter in a form) do nothing; the button keeps its focus and looks, with `aria-busy` and `aria-disabled` for screen readers.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Shows the close button.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the close button. Defaults to the `close` label.

ChartCard.description: The card every chart sits in: bg/card, a border-default edge, radius-2xl, 16px in and 16 between rows. Row one: the title (16/24 medium, text/default) and, when there are `periods`, a small Select for the period at the right. Row two: the KPI (text/xl semibold) with its change badge, and the range under it in text/muted, 2px apart; without a KPI the range sits 4px under the title. Then the chart. The card is a size container, so a chart can lay itself out wider from 560px (`@min-[560px]:`).

ChartLegendPill.description: chart/legendPill. - `outline`: an outline pill with no fill — 8px swatch, label, value 6 apart, 6 / 10 in. Active turns the ring border-strong. - `plain` (the Donut legend): no ring and no value, 6 / 8 in; active fills bg/hover, as plain controls do on hover. Dimmed fades the content to 45%, never the ground.

ChartTooltip.description: The chart tooltip pill with its pointer. Exported for custom charts. With `anchor` it floats over the page (see Floating): it never gets cut off by the card, flips below when there's no room above, slides in from the screen edge, and its pointer keeps pointing at the anchor. Without it, it renders in place.

props.name: anchor
props.description: The element it points at.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Gap between the anchor and the pointer's tip.

ChartLegendRow.description: One legend row: 8px swatch, label, value and an optional note.

props.name: placement
props.description: Which side of the text the box sits on.

ChipAvatar.description: The 16px initials avatar from Figma: tone-bg, 7px semibold tone-fg.

props.name: index
props.description: 1-based, as in the Sources list.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Start with the list open.

props.name: highlightLines
props.description: 1-based line numbers to mark (code view).

props.name: highlight
props.description: Turn syntax colours off for plain output such as logs.

props.name: options
props.description: Options, or titled groups of options.

props.name: value
props.description: The applied picks.

props.name: footer
props.description: Cancel and Apply under the list; picks apply only with Apply.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while nothing is picked. Defaults to the `select` label ("Select…").

props.name: searchPlaceholder

props.name: children

KanbanCard.description: A card for `renderCard`, laid out like a sales pipeline's lead: Satin's Card (small) with a title row (logo, title, ⋯ menu), a status Badge and a line of meta under it, labelled `fields`, then a bottom row with the `footer`, the age (amber when `stale`) and an avatar. Children go between the fields and the bottom row. The ⋯ menu moves the card without dragging; it shows on hover and focus (always on touch screens). Other props, `ref` included, go to the Card.

props.name: title
props.description: What the card is: a company, a person, an order. A Link when it opens a page.

props.name: logo
props.description: Before the title, in the fields' icon column: a 16px logo, or a 16px Avatar (rounded for a company).

props.name: status
props.description: A Badge under the title for what's happening to it ("Nudged by agent · 2h"). Screen readers hear it as the card's description.

props.name: meta
props.description: One line under the title, in text/muted: a role, an amount, a date.

props.name: fields
props.description: Labelled lines, 8px apart: icon and value, each label for screen readers.

props.name: footer
props.description: The start of the bottom row: counts (comments, tasks), Badges.

props.name: age
props.description: How long it has been in its column ("3d"), with a clock, at the end of the bottom row.

props.name: stale
props.description: It has waited too long: the age turns into an amber Badge with an alert clock, and reads "stale".

props.name: avatar
props.description: An Avatar or AvatarGroup at the end of the bottom row: who owns it.

props.name: changed
props.description: A key for what the card shows (a version, an updated-at time). When it changes, not on first render nor when the card moves, the card lights up once and the board reads "Northwind Labs was updated". For changes nobody watched happen: an agent's, a teammate's.

props.name: actions
props.description: More DropdownMenuItems for the ⋯ menu, after the moves.

props.name: moveActions
props.description: "Move to" each other column, and up and down, in the ⋯ menu.

KbdGroup.description: The keys of one shortcut, 2px apart.

props.name: keys
props.description: A shortcut such as "⌘K" or "⌃⇧V", split into keys, or the keys themselves.

KbdHint.description: A key hint for a menu footer: keys, then what they do in 12px text/muted, 6px apart.

props.name: labels
props.description: The words to change; the rest stay as they are (from a parent SatinLabels, or English).

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit after the value in the tooltip ("orders").

props.name: area
props.description: Fill under the line. `AreaCard` sets it.

props.name: labelEvery
props.description: Show every nth x label, counted back from the last point (3 for every third month of a year). Left out, about seven labels spread across the plot (five when they are dates).

props.name: reducedMotion
props.description: Swap the plot without the fade when the data changes, as under prefers-reduced-motion.

AreaCard.description: The Line chart with the gradient under its line.

props.name: icon

props.name: media

props.name: target

props.name: variant

props.name: timestamp

props.name: feedback

props.name: thinking

props.name: thinkingLabel

props.name: source
props.description: A page or message the user brought in, shown as a card above their bubble.

props.name: actions
props.description: Feedback, copy and share under an assistant answer. Off while it streams.

props.name: media

props.name: badge

props.name: stacked
props.description: Plain cards peeking below it, for a folded group: 0, 1 or 2. Ignored inside a NotificationStack.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows the close button on the top-right corner; called when it is pressed.

props.name: children

props.name: label

RichTextLinkButton.description: A toolbar toggle that opens the link popover (as ⌘K does): pressed while the selection is in a link. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `button`.

RichTextToolbar.description: The formatting toolbar, inside the field above the text (`RichTextEditorContent`'s children), a subtle rule under it. Free's `Toolbar` with `preventFocusOnPress`, so a press keeps the selection; one tab stop, ← → between items, ⌥F10 from the text reaches its first item and Escape goes back to the text. Hidden when read-only; its items are disabled with the editor. `children` replace the preset: build one from `RichTextBlockTypeMenu`, `RichTextFormatToggle`, `RichTextBlockToggle`, `RichTextLinkButton` and Free's `ToolbarSeparator`, `ToolbarButton`. Other props, `ref` included, go to the toolbar `div`.

props.name: preset
props.description: `'default'`: text style | bold, italic, strikethrough, code | bullet list, numbered list, quote | link. `'minimal'`: bold, italic | bullet list | link. `children` replace either.

RichTextSelectionToolbar.description: The bubble over a selection: Free's `Toolbar variant="floating"` placed by `Floating` above the selected text. It shows after a pointer selection (on release) or a double click, never for a selection made with the keyboard; it follows a selection changed while it's up, and goes with a collapsed selection, Escape, or focus leaving the text and the bubble. It doesn't take focus or sit in the tab order: ⌥F10 in the text reaches it when there's no fixed toolbar (and opens it on the caret), and Escape in it goes back to the text with the selection. `children` replace bold, italic, strikethrough and link; `actions` add to them after a separator. That's the place for actions on the selected text (an AI rewrite, a comment): any Toolbar item, with `editorRef`'s `getSelectionRect`, `insert` and `insertText` to act. Not drawn when the editor is read-only or disabled. Other props go to the toolbar `div`.

props.description: Added after the items, past a separator: actions on the selection (rewrite, translate, comment). They get the same context as the formatting items.

props.description: Called with midnight (in `timeZone`) of the new day as the period changes.

props.name: events
props.description: The events. Leave it out and pass `defaultEvents` to let the Scheduler keep them.

props.name: onEventChange
props.description: After a drag, a resize or a keyboard move: the event with its new times, then as it was.

props.name: onEventOpen
props.description: A click, Enter or Space on an event.

props.name: onSlotSelect
props.description: Slots picked with the pointer or Enter: their start and end, or a whole day.

props.name: availability
props.description: Free or busy times, drawn under the events.

props.name: slotMinutes
props.description: Minutes per slot: the rows, the drag steps and the keyboard steps.

props.name: workingHours
props.description: From and to, in hours (`[9, 18]`); outside them the grid is bg/canvas.

props.name: timeZone
props.description: An IANA time zone ("Europe/Warsaw"). Defaults to the browser's.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: The week's first day, 0 (Sunday) to 6. Defaults to `dateLocale`'s.

props.name: now
props.description: Now, for the now line and today. Defaults to the clock, updated every minute.

props.name: eventPopover
props.description: The body of a popover that opens on an event, under its title and time (and attendees).

props.name: slotPopover
props.description: The body of a popover that opens on picked slots, under "New event" and the time.

props.name: container
props.description: Portal target for the popovers and hover cards.

SchedulerToolbar.description: Today, ‹ ›, the period (a button that opens a DatePickerPanel) and the view switch. `children` go before the switch (a "New event" button, a filter). Other props, `ref` included, go to its `div`.

SchedulerGrid.description: The current view: day and week as a time grid, month as day cells. A new view crossfades in. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `div` that holds it.

Scheduler.description: The toolbar over the current view. Other props, `ref` included, go to the card's root `div`. <Scheduler events={events} onEventChange={(e) => save(e)} onSlotSelect={(slot) => create(slot)} timeZone="Europe/Warsaw" />

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Show the ⌘K keycaps and listen for the shortcut.

props.name: hotkey
props.description: Listen for ⌘K / Ctrl+K. Defaults to `shortcut`; turn it off when something else owns the shortcut (a Command menu this bar opens) but the keycaps should still show.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Classes for the outer field; `className` styles the input.

props.name: variant
props.description: `field`: the 32px bar. `panel`: the search row over its results and a footer of key hints.

props.name: groups
props.description: panel: what can be found, grouped, as in CommandMenu.

props.name: idleText
props.description: panel: shown before anything is typed, e.g. what the search looks through. Without it, every item.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: panel: shown when nothing matches; gets the query. Defaults to the `noResultsFor` label.

props.name: meta
props.description: panel: on the right of the footer, e.g. "59 settings indexed".

props.name: hints
props.description: panel: show the Navigate and Open key hints.

SegmentedControlSegment.description: One segment, for SegmentedControl's children. Takes its size and shape from the control.

props.name: items
props.description: The segments as data. Or leave it out and write them as `SegmentedControlSegment` children.

props.name: children
props.description: The segments as elements, when they need more than a label and an icon (a Badge, a Tooltip around one).

props.name: border
props.description: A border-subtle outline around the track (border-width/strong: the track is a control).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Required when the segments have no visible text of their own.

FieldChrome.description: @internal Shared by Satin's own components; not part of the public API and may change in any release.

props.name: action
props.description: On the label's line, at the field's right edge: the smallest button, e.g. Clear.

SelectChevron.description: @internal Shared by Satin's own components; not part of the public API and may change in any release.

props.name: options
props.description: Options, or titled groups of options.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while nothing is picked. Defaults to the `select` label ("Select…").

props.name: error
props.description: An error message (replaces the hint), or `true` to mark the field invalid without one.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: A 16px icon before the value. Left out, the picked option's own icon shows there.

props.name: layout
props.description: Row layout of every option: description under the label, or after it.

props.name: iconSize
props.description: Option icon size; 20 suits stacked two-line options.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name, for a native form submit.

props.name: container
props.description: Portal target. Defaults to `document.body`.

props.name: menuMaxHeight
props.description: Caps the menu's height in px; past it the list scrolls. Left out, the menu takes the room the window has.

props.name: menuAlign
props.description: Which edge of the field the menu lines up with. Defaults to `"start"`; `"end"` for a field at the end of a row.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Classes for the outer wrapper (label + field + hint). `className` styles the trigger.

props.name: data-force
props.description: Show a state without interacting, for state sheets.

SelectableCardBody.description: @internal The icon tile and the text of a selectable card.

props.name: label
props.description: A word in the middle of a horizontal rule.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Optional element that opens the sheet (rendered with `asChild`, so pass a Button).

props.name: footer
props.description: The buttons at the bottom. Wrap one in `SheetClose` to make it close the sheet.

props.name: modal
props.description: Modal blocks the page and shows the overlay; turn it off for inline previews.

props.name: container
props.description: Portal target. Defaults to `document.body`.

Sidebar.description: The navigation landmark. Name it with `aria-label` when a page has more than one nav.

props.name: active
props.description: The current page. Sets `aria-current="page"`.

props.name: count
props.description: Unread or pending work. Hidden at 0.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: The collapsed rail: icon only, label in a tooltip.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render your router's link instead of `<a>`.

props.name: count
props.description: How many items the group holds.

props.name: triggerProps
props.description: Forwarded to the header button, e.g. `data-force="hover"` on a state sheet.

props.name: children
props.description: Its `SidebarSubItem`s; they sit 12px further in.

props.name: active
props.description: One of its sub-items is the current page: opens it by default and marks the label.

props.name: value
props.description: A number, or a `[from, to]` pair for a range.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Every change while it moves. Gets a number or a pair, as given.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: Once, when a drag ends or a key or a typed value changes it.

props.name: minStepsBetweenThumbs
props.description: Smallest gap between the range's thumbs, in steps.

props.name: showValue
props.description: The picked value at the right of the label's line. Hidden while `inputs` are on.

props.name: inputs
props.description: Small number fields beside the track to type the value.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: The value in a bubble over the thumb while it moves.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: How a value reads in the readout, the bubble, the fields' neighbours and to screen readers.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name, for a native form submit.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the slider when there is no `label`.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer wrapper.

props.name: label
props.description: What's loading, for screen readers. `null` hides the spinner from them.

props.name: menu
props.description: The related actions: `DropdownMenuItem`s, optionally in `DropdownMenuGroup`s.

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the arrow.

props.name: menuProps
props.description: Passed to the DropdownMenu: `align` (default `end`), `side`, `open`, `onOpenChange`…

props.name: groupClassName
props.description: Class names for the group around both halves.

StepperItem.description: One step, for the Stepper's children: the place to put content under a vertical step, or a label that needs more than text (a Badge). Takes its number and state from its place. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `li`.

props.name: value
props.description: Names the step; the Stepper's `value` picks the current one.

props.name: description
props.description: A line under the label: what the step asks for, or what went wrong.

props.name: state
props.description: See `StepperStep.state`.

props.name: children
props.description: The step's content, shown under its label while it is the current step (vertical only).

props.name: steps
props.description: The steps as data. Or leave it out and write them as `StepperItem` children.

props.name: children
props.description: The steps as elements, when one needs content under it or more than text in its label.

props.name: value
props.description: The current step's `value`. A value that matches no step leaves none current.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The current step to start on, uncontrolled. Defaults to the first.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with a step's `value` when it is clicked (only when `linear` is false).

props.name: orientation
props.description: Steps in a row with their labels under them, or down the start side with content under the current one.

props.name: linear
props.description: True: steps go in order, the ones before the current step are complete, and none is clickable. False: every step that isn't disabled is a button that makes it current.

props.name: layout
props.description: `auto`: a horizontal stepper narrower than 120px a step shows "Step 3 of 4" over a Progress bar instead. `full` always shows the steps, `compact` always the count and bar.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the list of steps.

props.name: text
props.description: Everything received so far. Grow it as chunks arrive.

props.name: streaming
props.description: More is coming: keeps the caret and the pace going.

props.name: speed
props.description: Letters written a second at the even pace.

props.name: caret
props.description: The caret at the end while it writes.

props.name: onDone
props.description: Called once everything received is written and `streaming` is off.

TableRowToggle.description: The chevron that opens a row: a tertiary xs icon Button with `aria-expanded`, pointing to the row's end when closed and down when open. Other props, `ref` included, go to the button.

props.name: name
props.description: The row it opens, for its name: "Rows under <name>".

props.name: getSubRows
props.description: A row's own rows, shown under it when it's open. Rows without any get no chevron.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Ids of the open rows (controlled).

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Ids of the rows open at first (uncontrolled).

props.name: groupBy
props.description: Gathers the rows under a header row per value of this field.

props.name: groupOrder
props.description: Group values in the order to show them; groups left out follow, in the order of their first row.

props.name: renderGroup
props.description: Draws a group's name in its header (a Badge, say); the value as text by default.

props.name: collapsedGroups
props.description: Values of the closed groups (controlled). Groups are open unless listed.

props.name: defaultCollapsedGroups
props.description: Values of the groups closed at first (uncontrolled).

props.name: pinned
props.description: Keeps the first column (and the checkbox column) in place while the rest scroll sideways, with a shadow over them.

props.name: footer
props.description: Adds the totals row, in a `<tfoot>`: "Total", then each column's `aggregate` in its `format`.

props.name: density
props.description: Row height: 40px, or 32px with `compact`.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Ids of the rows picked at first (uncontrolled).

props.name: renderCell
props.type: (cell: { row: R; column: TableGroupedColumn<R>; depth: number; content: React.ReactNode }) => React.ReactNode
props.description: Draws a body cell's content, after the column's own `cell`; the first column keeps the chevron and the indent in front of it. `depth` is 0 for a row you passed, 1 for its sub-rows.

props.name: renderRow
props.type: (row: { row: R; depth: number; selected: boolean; rowProps: React.ComponentProps<'tr'>; children: React.ReactNode }) => React.ReactNode
props.description: Draws each body row, as Table's `renderRow`: spread `rowProps` (focus, keys, ARIA and styles) on your `<tr>` and put `children` inside. Group header rows are drawn by the table.

props.name: onSortChange
props.description: Called with the new sort; rows are sorted by value unless `manualSort` is set.

props.name: manualSort
props.description: Leave rows in the order given (sort them yourself in onSortChange).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the table.

props.name: rowLabel
props.description: Names a row for its select checkbox ("Select Acme Corp" instead of "Select row 3"), e.g. `(row) => row.name`. `index` is the row's place as shown, from 0. Without it the checkbox says the row's number, which changes when the table is sorted.

props.name: renderCell
props.type: (cell: { row: R; column: Column<R>; index: number; content: React.ReactNode }) => React.ReactNode
props.description: Draws every body cell's content, after the column's own `cell`: `content` is what the cell would show. Wrap it (a link to the row's page), or replace it; the cell keeps its padding, alignment and truncation.

props.name: renderRow
props.type: (row: { row: R; index: number; selected: boolean; rowProps: React.ComponentProps<'tr'>; children: React.ReactNode }) => React.ReactNode
props.description: Draws each body row. Spread `rowProps` (state and styles) on your `<tr>` and put `children` (the cells) inside, to add a handler, a data attribute or a context provider: `renderRow={({ row, rowProps, children }) => <tr {...rowProps} onClick={() => open(row)}>{children}</tr>}`.

props.name: footer
props.description: Rows for a `<tfoot>` under the body, such as a totals row: give `<tr>`s with one cell per column, plus one first for the checkbox column when `selectable`.

props.name: tableProps
props.description: Props for the `<table>` element itself (the rest go to the frame around it): a `role` such as `"treegrid"` when rows expand, `aria-*`, handlers. `className` and `style` add to the table's own.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable every tab.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the tab list.

props.name: children
props.description: `TabsContent` panels, one per item value.

TabsContent.description: The panel for one tab value.

props.name: optional
props.description: Adds a muted "(Optional)" after the label: the `optional` label.

props.name: error
props.description: An error message (replaces the hint), or `true` to mark the field invalid without one.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Shows a `length/maxLength` counter.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Classes for the outer wrapper (label + field + hint row). `className` styles the field.

props.name: data-force
props.description: Show a state without interacting, for state sheets.

CharacterCount.description: A character counter, the one under Textarea: "134/120" against a limit, in text/destructive once over it, with "Characters used:" before it for screen readers; or, with no limit, the count in words ("948 characters", the `characterCount` label, the number written in `dateLocale`). Muted 14px by default, set to stay on one line at the end of a hint row. It isn't a live region (it changes on every key); point the field's `aria-describedby` at its `id`. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `p`.

props.name: count
props.description: The characters so far.

props.name: max
props.description: The limit. With it the count reads "134/120"; without it, "948 characters".

props.name: state
props.description: collapsed once the agent is done, expanded when people open it.

props.name: label
props.description: The summary, e.g. "Thought for 2m 45s". Defaults to the `thought` label ("Thought").

props.name: indicator
props.description: The mark beside the summary.

TimeList.description: The list of times on its own: a focusable `listbox`, named "Time" (the `time` label) unless you name it. Arrows move the highlight, Home and End go to the first and last time, Page Up and Down an hour, typing jumps to the time typed, Enter or Space picks. Give it a height (or a flex parent) and it scrolls. Other props, `ref` included, go to the listbox.

props.name: value
props.description: The picked time.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when a time is picked (click, Enter or Space).

props.name: step
props.description: Minutes between the listed times, from midnight.

props.name: min
props.description: Times before this are dimmed and can't be picked.

props.name: max
props.description: Times after this are dimmed and can't be picked.

props.name: isTimeDisabled
props.description: Dims a time and keeps it from being picked: a booked slot, a lunch break.

props.name: format
props.description: 12- or 24-hour. Defaults to how the `dateLocale` label's locale writes times.

TimePicker.description: A time field: type a time or pick one from the list under it. Other props, `ref` included, go to the text input; `className` styles the field around it.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: A picked or typed time; `null` when the field is cleared or what was typed can't be picked.

props.name: step
props.description: Minutes between the listed times, from midnight. Typed times needn't fall on a step.

props.name: min
props.description: Times before this are dimmed in the list, and typing one marks the field invalid.

props.name: max
props.description: Times after this are dimmed in the list, and typing one marks the field invalid.

props.name: isTimeDisabled
props.description: Dims a time and keeps it from being picked or typed: a booked slot, a lunch break.

props.name: format
props.description: 12- or 24-hour. Defaults to how the `dateLocale` label's locale writes times.

props.name: open
props.description: The list of times.

props.name: error
props.description: An error message (replaces the hint), or `true` to mark the field invalid without one.

props.name: container
props.description: Portal target. Defaults to `document.body`.

props.name: onInteractOutside
props.description: A press outside the field and the list; `preventDefault()` keeps the list open.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Classes for the outer wrapper (label + field + hint). `className` styles the field.

props.name: data-force
props.description: Show a state without interacting, for state sheets.

DateTimePickerPanel.description: The date-and-time panel on its own, in place: DatePickerPanel's calendar with a column of times beside it. Picking a day moves focus to the times. Other props, `ref` included, go to the surface.

props.name: value
props.description: The picked date and time.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called once a day and a time are both picked, and on every change after.

DateTimePicker.description: A date and time field: DatePicker's field, with a clock's worth of times beside the calendar. Pick a day and a time; each pick sets the value and the panel stays open until Escape, a press outside, or Enter on the picked time. Other props, `ref` included, go to the trigger button.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called once a day and a time are both picked, and on every change after.

props.name: error
props.description: An error message (replaces the hint), or `true` to mark the field invalid without one.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while nothing is picked. Defaults to the `pickDateTime` label.

props.name: name
props.description: Submits `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` with a form, as `<input type="datetime-local">` does.

props.name: container
props.description: Portal target. Defaults to `document.body`.

props.name: onOpenAutoFocus
props.description: Called as the panel opens and takes focus; `preventDefault()` leaves focus where it was.

props.name: onInteractOutside
props.description: A press outside the panel; `preventDefault()` keeps it open.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Classes for the outer wrapper (label + field + hint). `className` styles the field.

Toast.description: A single toast on its own. Lives inside `<Toaster>` (it needs the Radix toast provider).

props.name: details
props.description: Under the toast's row, aligned with its text: a list, a progress bar.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the viewport; `absolute` instead of `fixed` keeps it inside a positioned parent.

props.name: limit
props.description: Most toasts on screen at once; the rest wait behind.

props.name: children
props.description: Your own controlled `<Toast>`s, rendered alongside the ones from `toast()`.

props.name: icon
props.description: A 16px icon before the label, or the only content when `iconOnly` (then pass an aria-label).

props.name: data-force
props.description: Show a state without interacting, for state sheets.

ToolCallRoot.description: The card and its open state. Other props, `ref` included, go to the card's `<div>`.

props.name: open
props.description: Open, controlled.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Open at first, uncontrolled. Left out, it follows the status: open only on `error`.

props.name: startedAt
props.description: When the call started, for the time shown while it runs. Defaults to when this card first saw it running.

ToolCallHeader.description: The button that opens and folds the card. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `<button>`.

props.name: name
props.description: The tool, e.g. "Find slots".

props.name: icon
props.description: A 16px icon before the name. Defaults to a hammer and wrench.

props.name: target
props.description: What it ran on, in mono after the name: a function, a file, a URL. Truncates.

props.name: duration
props.description: How long the call took, in ms, shown once it ends. Defaults to the time this card measured.

ToolCallContent.description: The body under the header: its sections, a rule between each. Folded, it stays mounted but leaves tab order and screen readers. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `<div>` that holds the sections.

ToolCallSection.description: One titled part of the body: JSON (or a string) in a CodeBlock with Copy, or the app's own node under the title. Other props, `ref` included, go to the section's `<div>`.

props.name: title
props.description: What it holds, e.g. "Input". Names the CodeBlock (as its file name) or the group.

props.name: maxLines
props.description: JSON longer than this is cut at that line, with "Show all N lines" under it.

ToolCallError.description: What went wrong, in red, with Retry. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `<div>`.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Shows Retry. Focus goes back to the header, since Retry leaves with the error.

ToolCall.description: One tool call as a card. Other props, `ref` included, go to the card's `<div>`.

props.name: name
props.description: The tool, e.g. "Find slots".

props.name: icon
props.description: A 16px icon before the name. Defaults to a hammer and wrench.

props.name: target
props.description: What it ran on, in mono after the name: a function, a file, a URL. Truncates.

props.name: input
props.description: The arguments: JSON in a CodeBlock, or a node of your own.

props.name: output
props.description: What came back: JSON in a CodeBlock, or a node of your own.

props.name: error
props.description: What went wrong, shown on `error` above the output.

props.name: duration
props.description: How long the call took, in ms, shown once it ends. Defaults to the time this card measured.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Shows Retry on `error`.

props.name: maxLines
props.description: JSON longer than this is cut at that line, with "Show all N lines" under it.

props.name: preventFocusOnPress
props.description: Keep a press on an item from moving focus to it (an editor keeps its selection).

ToolbarSeparator.description: A thin rule between sets of items: the ButtonGroupSeparator look, a `separator` across the toolbar. Other props, `ref` included, go to its `div`.

props.name: label
props.description: The action, in one or two words.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Keys that run the action, e.g. "⌘K" or "⌃⇧V".

props.name: delay
props.description: Hover delay in ms before it opens.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: How long it stays after the pointer leaves, in ms, so a quick slip off the trigger doesn't flicker it.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger. It must be focusable (a button, a link).

props.name: container
props.description: Portal target. Defaults to `document.body`.
